purpose: Matched native whole-workflow cost disclosure for the bounded completion extension; not a general speedup claim
cases: decimal four-angle cube union, independent cube oracle, empty difference, and strict empty union continuation
original six translated icosahedron unions with existing per-step closed-manifold validation and representation-size queries
phases: first fresh workflow in a new process
second fresh workflow in that process; only retained built-in/shared state may be warm
samples: One elapsed interval per phase and process, eight predeclared balanced randomized baseline/candidate pairs after one functional pair. No extra sampling or metric exclusions.
timing: Full construction, transformations, operations, validation and ordinary intermediate drops; exact artifact extraction, serialization and final returned-object drop outside timing. Icosahedron chain keeps only the final mesh for post-timing exact artifact comparison.
analysis: Paired log-ratio Student t, marginal95% and Bonferroni simultaneous95% across four metrics. Inconclusive does not pass the general performance gate.
artifacts: Every sampled final mesh has exact quadratic coordinate triples and triangle indices compared byte-for-byte, plus per-step certainty/topology/count/depth receipts. All scalar normal forms must succeed or this probe fails; no recursive Debug or expression serialization. The decimal case also has the independent six-half-space and unit-volume oracle. Existing polyhedron tests remain separate compatibility gates, not an independent set oracle.
containment: Each process600s/8GiB/64MiBfile, CPU pinned. No heavy task work concurrent with final timings. Same private checkout, exclusive native target, frozen binaries, System allocator, curve/stl-io/obj-io features, no dispatch tracing.
allocation_scope: Separate scalar predicate allocation campaign; this native whole-workflow probe records process maximum RSS only.
